description:
SignalRaven monitors LinkedIn for the conversations that matter to a B2B seller: posts by competitors and their employees, keyword and industry searches, brand mentions, and your own content. When someone engages, SignalRaven qualifies them against your ideal customer profile through 14 review gates, scores urgency from 1 to 10, and delivers a signal: who they are, what they engaged with, why it matters, and a suggested opener drafted from what they posted.

With this plugin, ChatGPT and Codex read your SignalRaven workspace and help you act on it.

What you can do: see your strongest signals this week and open any of them with the person, the ICP analysis, why it matters, the suggested opener and the talking points. Draft three openers that cite what the person actually posted. List the sources you monitor with their metrics, read your watchlist and your ICP profile. Open Account and Person Intelligence reports. See workspace usage and where signals are delivered. With the write permissions you grant on the consent screen, start an Account or Person Intelligence run from a LinkedIn URL (spends credits) and create or update a delivery destination.

Safe by design: the plugin reads your own workspace over an OAuth connection you approve and can revoke. Monitoring runs on SignalRaven's infrastructure. It never touches your LinkedIn login, cookies or session. Anything that spends credits or changes where signals go sits behind its own named permission.

A trial or paid SignalRaven workspace gets live data. Any other account can connect and explore with clearly labeled sample data.

defaultPrompt: Strongest signals - Show my strongest signals this week and draft an opener for each.
Pre-call research - Research [person] before my call: what did they engage with, and what should I say?
Account intelligence - Run Account Intelligence on [company] and tell me who to email first.
